# Compatibility Requirements Checklist: S3-Compatible Local Storage Server

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of compatibility requirements — S3 protocol/wire compatibility, client-ecosystem interop, MinIO alignment, and platform/toolchain compatibility — as "unit tests for requirements" against spec.md, plan.md, and the contracts.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/s3-surface.md](../contracts/s3-surface.md) | [contracts/minio-compat.md](../contracts/minio-compat.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. S3 Protocol Compatibility — Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the implemented operation surface (~30 operations across buckets/objects/listing/multipart) enumerated in the requirements with each operation traceable to its FR? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-015, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(s3-surface.md ops table annotates each op with its FR; FR-001–FR-015 define the requirements; automated coverage: crates/tinio-e2e/tests/features/{buckets,objects,listing,multipart,error_codes,conditions,tagging,metrics,reserved_paths}.feature)*
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior of the ~69 unimplemented S3 trait operations specified as a uniform NotImplemented response, including its interaction with the capability toggles (compile-time features vs runtime `[s3]` keys)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(s3-surface.md: "All other operations of the S3 trait (99 total) return standard NotImplemented errors"; two-layer behavior in §FR-021 + line 28; automated: error_codes.feature @FR-021, incl. the @minimal-caps NotImplemented scenario)*
- [x] CHK003 Is the full required error-code set specified (NoSuchBucket, NoSuchKey, InvalidBucketName, BucketAlreadyExists, BucketNotEmpty, InvalidAccessKeyId/SignatureDoesNotMatch, NotImplemented) together with the scenario that triggers each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(s3-surface.md line 22 pins the code list; Edge Cases section maps scenarios to codes; automated: error_codes.feature @SC-004)*
- [x] CHK004 Are conditional-request requirements (If-Match/If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since/If-Unmodified-Since → 304/412, Copy-source evaluation) defined with the date-based preconditions scoped to the read path? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications (plan review)] *(Clarifications: If-Modified-Since / If-Unmodified-Since are evaluated on Get/Head only (304/412); the PUT write path evaluates If-Match / If-None-Match only — If-Unmodified-Since on PUT is not supported; the Copy source is evaluated per S3 semantics; s3-surface.md "Conditional requests" note; automated: conditions.feature @FR-003, objects.feature @T025)*
- [x] CHK005 Is the SigV2 support requirement specified (off by default, enable only for legacy clients, weaker-scheme rationale) rather than implied? [Completeness, contracts/s3-surface.md, research.md] *(s3-surface.md: "disabled by default ([s3] sig_v2 = false); enable only for legacy clients"; research.md: weaker scheme — HMAC-SHA1, no payload signing)*
- [x] CHK006 Are addressing-style requirements complete — path-style as the supported mode, virtual-hosted explicitly excluded for v1, both mandated clients working against `127.0.0.1` with no client-side overrides — including the documented consequence for clients that assume virtual-hosted addressing? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, Spec §SC-002] *(Assumptions: path-style expected, "virtual-hosted addressing is not configured in v1"; research.md: fallback must not require overrides; FR-025 catch-all covers other clients; automated: interop/journey.feature @SC-002)*

## 2. S3 Protocol Compatibility — Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Are "standard S3 semantics" for listing (prefix filtering, delimiter grouping, pagination, continuation) specified concretely enough to implement without deferring to the framework? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] *(FR-004 names prefix/delimiter grouping; pagination per S3 semantics is delegated to the framework — an intentional, documented deferral per the framework-authoritative assumption, see CHK039; automated: listing.feature @SC-001 @FR-004)*
- [x] CHK008 Is the ETag contract unambiguous — MD5 for single uploads, `MD5-of-part-MD5s-N` for multipart, meta-store validation against size/mtime, recompute-on-stale, and the known granularity limit of out-of-band edits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022] *(FR-022 specifies all elements incl. the size/mtime granularity limit; automated: objects.feature @FR-022, multipart.feature @FR-014 composed-ETag scenarios)*
- [x] CHK009 Are Range-request requirements (partial content 206, Content-Range header) specified? [Clarity, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(s3-surface.md: "Range → seek + 206/Content-Range"; automated: objects.feature @T025 range matrix incl. 416 InvalidRange)*
- [x] CHK010 Is the folder-marker contract (keys ending in `/` are never objects; PUT creates the directory, GET/HEAD → NoSuchKey, DELETE removes an empty directory) — including behavior when the marker collides with an existing directory — unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(PUT collision specified as idempotent; non-empty DELETE resolved 2026-08-22: always 204, directory removed only when empty — s3-surface.md + Clarifications updated; automated: objects.feature @T025 folder-marker scenario)*
- [x] CHK011 Is "standard S3 error" (FR-005) pinned to an explicit error-code list rather than left as a general reference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] *(FR-005 uses "and so on" but s3-surface.md line 22 pins the explicit list; framework-authoritative assumption covers the remainder; automated: error_codes.feature @SC-004 @FR-005)*

## 3. S3 Protocol Compatibility — Consistency & Conflicts

- [x] CHK012 Do the two-layer capability requirements (FR-021 runtime toggles vs compile-time features) agree with the s3-surface contract (stripped groups → NotImplemented; their `[s3]` keys silently ignored)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(FR-021 + s3-surface.md line 28 + plan.md feature-off behaviors agree: stripped groups → NotImplemented, schema-known keys silently ignored, genuinely unknown keys rejected; automated: error_codes.feature @FR-021 @minimal-caps scenario)*
- [x] CHK013 Is the relationship between FR-012 bucket-name rules and the s3s framework's authoritative `check-bucket-name` rules (common-subset documentation) recorded without conflict? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, research.md] *(research.md: "the framework's rules are authoritative — FR-012 documents the common subset"; automated: error_codes.feature @FR-012 naming matrix)*
- [x] CHK014 Are read-only-mode rejection requirements (AccessDenied for all mutating ops) consistent with capability-toggle behavior (NotImplemented) for the same operations — no ambiguity about which error a client observes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(FR-023 vs FR-021 are distinct conditions, each specified for its own mode; s3-surface.md lines 28/30 restate both; not covered by cucumber — read-only mode is unimplemented US2 work)*
- [x] CHK015 Is the conditional-request semantic for the CopyObject source consistent with the target-side Put/Copy semantics per S3 behavior? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications (plan review)] *(Clarifications + s3-surface.md line 24: source evaluated per S3 semantics, target-side 412 specified; automated: conditions.feature @FR-014 UploadPartCopy conditionals)*

## 4. Client Ecosystem Interop

- [x] CHK016 Does SC-002 pin the mandated client set (aws cli v2, rclone) with an explicit operation matrix (create/upload/download/list/delete/multipart/copy) and the "no client-side workarounds or custom configuration" clause? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002] *(SC-002 + research.md: interop covers "the core journey (create/upload/download/list/delete/multipart/copy)"; automated: interop/journey.feature @SC-002 @T032, interop/advanced.feature @T033)*
- [x] CHK017 Are compatibility requirements (or explicit exclusions) defined for clients beyond the mandated two — boto3, mc, minio-go, other SDKs? [Gap] *(Resolved 2026-08-22: FR-025 defines the three-set contract — mandated / best-effort (boto3, mc) / unsupported catch-all; automated: interop/journey.feature + interop/advanced.feature @FR-025, @boto3 scenarios @T034, @mc scenarios @T035)*
- [x] CHK018 Are interop verification requirements specified across all three OS (Windows/Linux/macOS) including both `127.0.0.1` and `localhost` endpoints (virtual-hosted fallback must not require client overrides)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002, plan.md Testing] *(SC-002: 3-OS CI; plan.md: addressing-style tests against both endpoints; automated: interop/journey.feature @SC-002)*
- [x] CHK019 Are client-visible header behaviors that SDKs depend on specified — Content-Type inference, `x-amz-meta-*` accepted/dropped, `x-amz-checksum-*` validated behind `[s3] checksum` (default off) with deviations D1–D6 — so boto3/mc-based flows do not fail on unexpected responses? [Gap, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(s3-surface.md lines 20-21 specify all three; updated 2026-08-31: multipart checksums validated behind the toggle — per-part values (all ten `x-amz-checksum-*` algorithms, incl. SHA-512/XXHash*), create-algorithm consistency, pre-commit Complete validation (COMPOSITE/FULL_OBJECT); deviations D1–D5: UploadPart response echo only when the request carried a value (stored values echoed by ListParts), Complete validation skipped when stored part checksums are missing, PutObject/PostObject/CopyObject checksums stay accepted and dropped, no default CRC64NVME attach, UploadPartCopy computes server-side (no client value on the wire), the ten-variant `Algorithm` enum for wire parsing/create compute paths (value fields accepted-and-dropped; COMPOSITE legal, FULL_OBJECT CRC-only) — plus accept-without-validation for Complete values without a create-time algorithm (documented AWS behavior; assumed for CRC64NVME). FR-025 cross-references them as the best-effort set's known deviations; automated: the @checksum-on scenarios of error_codes.feature, multipart.feature, and interop/journey.feature)*
- [x] CHK020 Is the object-size compatibility requirement specified as a client-visible contract (no size limit, streamed with flat memory, zero-byte round-trip valid)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, Edge Cases] *(FR-010 + SC-003 + Edge Cases: unlimited size is an intentional choice, not an omission; automated: objects.feature @T025 zero-byte round-trip + interop/advanced.feature @T033 > 8 MiB transfers; flat-memory verification stays the planned SC-003 perf script (T089), not cucumber)*

## 5. MinIO Alignment

- [x] CHK021 Is the MinIO-style CLI contract (positional DIR for server/status/stop/doctor, `start` alias, `--address` alias, `--root` removal) specified in the requirements? [Completeness, contracts/minio-compat.md §1] *(§1 enumerates all; spec Clarifications Minio session records the user-facing decisions)*
- [x] CHK022 Are the port-default requirements (data plane 9000, management TCP 9001, `--port 0` ephemeral) unambiguous and collision-free (fixed-port examples never using 9001)? [Clarity, contracts/minio-compat.md §2] *(§2 table + explicit "fixed-port examples must never use 9001" convention)*
- [x] CHK023 Is the environment-variable fallback matrix complete and unambiguous (TINIO_* precedence; credential-only MINIO_* fallbacks incl. legacy vs modern names; no fallback for other variables)? [Completeness, contracts/minio-compat.md §3] *(§3 table covers precedence, both legacy/modern names, and the "all other variables are TINIO_-only" clause)*
- [x] CHK024 Are the `[scanner]` MinIO-aligned keys (delay/max_wait/cycle) mapped to MinIO scanner semantics without ambiguity, including presence-gating and the `TINIO_SCANNER` override? [Clarity, contracts/minio-compat.md §4–5] *(§4 maps each key to scanner semantics; §5 presence-based semantics; TINIO_SCANNER documented)*
- [x] CHK025 Are the documented deviations from MinIO (loopback-only default bind, `--anonymous`, non-adopted flags/env) prominent enough that requirements do not overclaim full MinIO compatibility? [Clarity, contracts/minio-compat.md §6] *(§6 lists deviations; spec Assumptions/FR-009 restate the two user-visible ones; the spec claims alignment, not identity)*

## 6. Platform & Toolchain Compatibility

- [x] CHK026 Are cross-platform requirements specified for case-insensitive filesystems (host semantics, no artificial enforcement, documented case-collision behavior)? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, Edge Cases] *(Assumptions + Edge Cases: "Host filesystem semantics apply; no artificial enforcement is added")*
- [x] CHK027 Is the platform-dependent key-charset rule specified (universal rules everywhere; Windows-invalid characters rejected on Windows only; future backends define their own)? [Clarity, contracts/s3-surface.md] *(Clarifications (plan review) + s3-surface.md line 26)*
- [x] CHK028 Are platform channel limitations recorded as known compatibility limits (unix socket 108-byte path limit; Windows named-pipe naming)? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, research.md] *(Assumptions: 108-byte limit documented; research.md: `\\.\pipe\tinio-<sha1(root)>` naming)*
- [x] CHK029 Is the Rust toolchain policy consistent across documents (edition 2024, latest-stable tracking, no pinned MSRV) and with constitution §VI MSRV discipline? [Consistency, plan.md, constitution §VI] *(Resolved 2026-08-22: plan.md now states "MSRV policy = current stable; if fixed-version pinning is ever needed, it will follow constitution §VI discipline (documented, CI-tested, raised only in MINOR/MAJOR)")*
- [x] CHK030 Are feature-combination compatibility requirements specified (7 independently strippable features; feature-off behaviors: config keys ignored, CLI options absent, no single-instance enforcement without `api`)? [Completeness, plan.md Structure Decision] *(Structure Decision enumerates all feature-off behaviors)*
- [x] CHK031 Is the semver commitment specified (facade crate as the only public API surface, `cargo-semver-checks` in CI) per constitution §VI? [Completeness, constitution §VI, plan.md] *(plan.md: facade is the semver-checks target; constitution §VI: semver-checks in CI)*
